tensuragacha.skill.gambler.description: A Unique Skill born from a soul that bet everything on its next life. Spin three reels: three of a kind grants a powerful blessing, a pair a small one, and no match leaves you sluggish. Mastery extends the blessings.

tensuragacha.race.celestial_slime.descri: An evolved Astral Slime that shines like a star. Born with the Unique Skill Gambler.
